Game Overview

Train Artillery Adventure puts players into a shooter experience centered on command a powerful artillery train in a thrilling battle against relentless zombie hordes. Strategically merge weapons, utilize diverse guns, and collect resources to customize your train and enhance firepower. Test your reflexes and tactical skills across intense levels as you obliterate enemies with devastating precision.

How to Play

Each session of Train Artillery Adventure follows a consistent rhythm. Command a powerful artillery train in a thrilling battle against relentless zombie hordes. Strategically merge weapons, utilize diverse guns, and collect resources to customize your train and enhance firepower. Test your reflexes and tactical skills across intense levels as you obliterate enemies with devastating precision.
